purpose: Font refinement of approved design prototype: smaller, gentler rounded Japanese headlines.

assets.headline: シンプルな表示
assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / precise typography edit.
Input image 1 is the approved Nagisa store screenshot poster and is the EDIT TARGET, not a style reference.
Perform ONE localized edit: replace only the large headline in the empty upper header area above the screenshot.
Make that headline approximately 20% smaller than it currently is. Change its typeface from the current very heavy angular Japanese gothic to a gentle rounded Japanese sans-serif / maru-gothic, similar to Zen Maru Gothic Medium or a clean modern rounded Gothic. Use medium weight (roughly 500), round stroke endings and corners, airy clear strokes. Friendly and restrained, not childish, handwritten, brush lettering, bubble lettering, outlined lettering, or extra bold. Keep good readability and the existing dark-violet text color.
Keep the headline's original left alignment and vertical center of its existing header area. Preserve its exact wording and existing line breaks.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: every pixel outside the headline lettering and the immediate background behind that lettering must remain unchanged. Keep the entire screenshot below the header COMPLETELY unchanged as a pasted raster layer, including all Japanese text, icons, photos, avatars, dialog, controls, app navigation, spacing, crop, sharpness, and colors. Do not regenerate, repaint, sharpen, blur, recolor, resize or reposition the embedded screenshot. Preserve its rectangle coordinates, rounded corners, shadow and scale exactly.
Preserve the existing lavender background gradient, glow, canvas aspect ratio and outer dimensions. Only the headline font, font weight and font size may change. Restore any area left by the smaller title with the original background. No added text, decorations or layout changes.
Output one opaque portrait PNG with the same 941 x 1672 dimensions as the source.
Exact headline text: "シンプルな表示".
Keep the headline on its existing single line.
